verdict.rationale: E2B can itself run work unattended. It documents a `--background` flag that returns immediately, sandboxes that run up to 24 hours with pause/resume for longer jobs, and running autonomous coding agents like Claude Code inside sandboxes. However, nothing in the evidence shows a way to define automations: no scheduler, cron, or event triggers, so the developer has to orchestrate when and how runs start. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/cron or trigger-based automation definitions, a managed recurring-job workflow, and hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.
